class.name: PathPrefixServer
class.brief_description: A table of path prefixes such as [code]user://[/code] or [code]mods://[/code], and safe path resolution.

method.name: create_folder_logic
method.description: Returns a [PathPrefix] that maps a prefix to [param folder]. [param folder] is an absolute path or a path with another prefix, for example [code]exec://mods[/code]; it is resolved on every call.

method.name: create_os_path_logic
method.description: Returns a [PathPrefix] that maps a prefix to an OS folder, see [enum OSPath].

method.name: create_system_dir_logic
method.description: Returns a [PathPrefix] that maps a prefix to the system folder [param dir], see [method OS.get_system_dir].

method.name: get_prefixes
method.description: Returns all registered prefixes in the order of their first registration. The engine prefixes come first.

method.name: globalize
method.description: Returns the real path for [param path]. Returns [param path] unchanged if it has no prefix, or if the prefix is unknown or not available.

method.name: has_prefix
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [param prefix] is registered, for any platform.

method.name: is_prefix_available
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [param prefix] is registered for this platform and its logic reports it as available.

method.name: is_prefix_locked
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [param prefix] is an engine prefix that cannot be changed.

method.name: is_prefix_read_only
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if paths with [param prefix] cannot be written to on this platform.

method.name: localize
method.description: Returns the prefixed path for the OS path [param global_path], or an empty string if it is not below any prefix. If several prefixes contain the path, the one with the deepest folder wins; on a tie the earlier registration wins (for example [code]res://[/code] before [code]exec://[/code] in the editor). The comparison ignores case on Windows and macOS.

method.name: register_prefix
method.description: Registers [param logic] for [param prefix]. [param prefix] consists of lowercase letters, digits and [code]_[/code], followed by [code]://[/code]; URL schemes such as [code]http://[/code] are not allowed. [param platforms] are feature tags (see [method OS.has_feature]), for example [code]["windows", "linux"][/code]. Empty means all platforms. A registration for named platforms that match wins over one for all platforms. Registering again with the same platforms replaces the logic. Returns [constant ERR_LOCKED] for engine prefixes and [constant ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER] for invalid names.

method.name: register_prefix_callable
method.description: Registers a prefix whose logic is given as callables: [param globalize] receives the prefixed path and returns the real path, [param localize] receives a real path and returns the prefixed path or an empty string, [param is_available] returns a [bool]. See [method register_prefix] for [param prefix] and [param platforms]. [b]Note:[/b] The callables can be called from any thread and must be thread-safe.

method.name: register_prefix_folder
method.description: Registers a prefix that maps to [param folder], see [method create_folder_logic] and [method register_prefix].

method.name: resolve
method.description: Resolves [param path] into a [PathInfo]. [param path] is a prefixed path, an OS path below a known prefix, or a path relative to [code]res://[/code]. Separators ([code]\\[/code] to [code]/[/code]), the case of the prefix and [code].[/code]/[code]..[/code] segments are normalized. An unknown prefix gives an invalid result instead of the unchanged input.

method.name: resolve_safe
method.description: Resolves an untrusted [param path] like [method resolve], but the result is invalid with [constant ERR_FILE_BAD_PATH] for [code]..[/code] segments, paths without a prefix (including absolute OS paths), unknown or unavailable prefixes, and paths outside [param allowed_roots] (for example [code]["user://saves/", "exec://mods/"][/code]). If [param for_write] is [code]true[/code] and the prefix is read-only, the result is invalid with [constant ERR_FILE_NO_PERMISSION]. [b]Note:[/b] Symbolic links and Windows short names are not resolved before the check.

method.name: unregister_prefix
method.description: Removes the registration of [param prefix] for [param platforms], or all its registrations if [param platforms] is empty. Returns [constant ERR_LOCKED] for engine prefixes and [constant ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST] if there is no such registration.

signal.name: prefix_registered
signal.description: Emitted on the main thread after [param prefix] was registered or replaced.

signal.name: prefix_unregistered
signal.description: Emitted on the main thread after a registration of [param prefix] was removed.
